tool: EBI GWAS Catalog REST API + Solr download endpoint
objective: Test whether common variants in Fanconi anemia genes (FANCA, FANCC, FANCD2, FANCG) or BRCA2/FANCD1 are GWAS-associated with glycemic/diabetes/insulin/beta-cell traits, to assess whether the FA glucose phenotype is tagged by common-variant signals vs. being a Mendelian (biallelic-loss) consequence.
method: singleNucleotidePolymorphisms/search/findByGene -> per-SNP associations -> efoTraits; trait strings screened for {glucose,glyc,diabet,insulin,hba1c,beta cell,islet,pancrea}.

glycemic_or_diabetes_traits: cysteinylglycine disulfide measurement (metabolite GWAS, NOT a glycemic/diabetes trait)
results.interpretation: No type 2 diabetes / fasting glucose / insulin / HbA1c / beta-cell trait among the 23/60 mapped SNPs checked. Bounded valid result.

results.note: Rate-limited (HTTP 429); positive control NOT established this run.

download_endpoint_attempt.outcome: FAILED for all genes including BRCA2 positive control; query syntax/endpoint not accepted this run.

limitations: Only FANCA returned a valid, bounded result (23 of 60 mapped SNPs checked).
FANCC/FANCD2/FANCG/BRCA2 not completed due to HTTP 429 rate-limiting.
BRCA2 positive control was NOT successfully established, so a genome-wide negative cannot be robustly asserted for the FA gene set.
REST 'associations/search/findByGene' returned 404 (invalid path) and must not be read as a biological negative.
This is labelled PARTIAL: it does not establish a confirmed source-level absence for the full FA gene set.
curation_claim: PARTIAL/INCONCLUSIVE. Suggestive that FANCA common variants are not GWAS-associated with glycemic traits (consistent with a Mendelian biallelic-loss mechanism rather than common-variant), but not a verified negative for the FA gene set. Recommend re-running with a validated positive control and completed FANCC/FANCD2/BRCA2 queries before curating an absence.
